🚨 MediaWiki security release: upgrade to 1.43.12, 1.45.7 or 1.46.3.

The announcement lists 38 security issues. One lets anyone read private wikis via the REST API. Others include more read permission gaps and stored XSS in Parsoid and VisualEditor. Fixes for non-bundled extensions follow later.

Upgrade PHP too: 8.2.36, 8.3.37, 8.4.28 or 8.5.13.

Details: https://lists.wikimedia.org/hyperkitty/list/mediawiki-announce@lists.wikimedia.org/thread/LHSEHQXIZ6RE63D7NIOEREQXB26JJLLE/

If your wiki is hosted with us, it is already patched.

#MediaWiki #Security #Sysadmin #SelfHosted @mediawiki@wikis.world
